newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse rises for third week.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse rises for third week.

text.p: The Abidjan Stock Exchange (BVA) rose for a third successive week in active trading, with brewery and tobacco shares helping the blue-chip index show a cumulative rise on the year for the first time.
The BVA weekly report showed the All-Share Index rising 1.96 percent to 369.26 points in the week to Friday, taking the rise for the year to 3.20 percent.
The 12 VB blue-chip index rose 1.69 percent to 245.58 points, recording a 1.49 percent rise on the year.

A total of 11,432 shares changed hands compared to 4,079 in the previous week and 6,176 before that. The value of shares traded totalled 315,515,500 CFA francs, more than the total value previously traded in the year to date.
Tobacco company SITAB (+4,450 CFA francs to 47,970 CFA) was the main riser and accounted for 3,400 shares traded or 151,554,760 CFA -- 48 percent of the total value traded.
Other risers were brewer SOLIBRA (+3,550 CFA to 65,100 CFA), cement company SOCIMAT (+1,550 CFA to 32,720), maritime company SIVOM (+1,480 to 16,060) and oil company SHELL (+1,210 to 13,140).
Cable company SICABLE (-2,110 CFA to 19,570) led fallers.
